sources.title: Hugging Face Unveils Microduck, New Open-Source Biped AI Robot
sources.snippet: Hugging Face, an organisation known for its open-source artificial intelligence models, has unveiled a new biped robot named Microduck. This device is 25 centimetres tall, weighs 800 grams, and is priced at USD 399. Pre-orders for Microduck commenced on Aug. 27, with shipping anticipated before Christmas 2026.

sources.title: Microduck - A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI ...
sources.snippet: Microduck - A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI experimentation and fun Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face have unveiled the Microduck, a 25 cm tall biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, a depth sensor, two motion sensors, and an articulated beak that can pick up objects.

sources.title: Microduck robot teaches robotics with fun, hackable design
sources.snippet: Learn robotics with the adorable, hackable Microduck robot from Pollen Robotics. Train skills and interact with the physical world. You can pre-order one now.
